name: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS)
issuingBody: Control Union Certifications B.V. / Global Standard GmbH
description: Certified organic processing standard for ecological and social criteria across the entire jute and cotton supply chain. Confirms non-toxic inputs, zero child labor, and verified organic origin.

name: OEKO-TEX® Standard 100
description: Internationally verified testing for harmful substances according to STANDARD 100 by OEKO-TEX® (Product Class 1: safe for food contact and sensitive touch).

name: Sedex Members Ethical Trade Audit (SMETA 4-Pillar)
description: Four-pillar ethical audit covering Labor Standards, Health & Safety, Environmental Assessment, and Business Ethics for global export compliance.

name: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System
description: Quality management certification governing precision manufacturing, yarn inspection, automated cutting, and export packaging repeatability.

name: ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management
description: Environmental compliance standard certifying zero-effluent discharge, solar-assisted drying, zero single-use plastics, and waste fiber composting.
